operations.name: Abner Green

expected.sentence:
About six months in jail.

Verdict as recorded: Convicted of contempt and jailed in 1951.

Charges as recorded: Contempt of court — for refusing to name contributors to the Civil Rights Congress Bail Fund.

operations.source: Primary appellate opinion Green v United States, 193 F.2d 111 (1951): https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/193/111/349397/ expressly dates first six-month contempt sentence July 27, 1951 and a concurrent second order July 30. Contemporary report confirms actual jailing: https://time.com/archive/6794304/national-affairs-the-mockers/ (August 6, 1951). Admission recorded only at MONTH precision, supported by contemporaneous July 28 jail report cited in https://www.stjohns.edu/sites/default/files/2019-02/JoL7-1%2C%20JICP2-1%2C%202Barrett.pdf . Do not confuse earlier July subpoenas with arrest or infer release by adding six months.

operations.name: Carlos Espriu

expected.name: Carlos Espriu
expected.description: Carlos Espriu, 23, of Palm Desert, CA was charged with attempted arson in the May 31, 2020 firebombing of the East Valley Republican Women Federated (EVRWF) office in La Quinta, CA. Espriu used a metal baseball bat to break windows at the EVRWF headquarters, then lit an improvised incendiary device of three bottles and tossed them through the windows before fleeing. He returned twice — once to retrieve the Molotovs, once to throw them, igniting a fire. Sentenced to 60 months federal prison plus $5,426 restitution.

operations.source: Primary Riverside County District Attorney press release September 10, 2020 explicitly identifies Carlos Espriu and DOB 5-22-97: https://rivcoda.org/sites/g/files/aldnop286/files/migrated/NEWS%20RELEASE%20--%20Palm%20Desert%20man%20arrested%20and%20charged%20in%20arson%20at%20La%20Quinta%20Republican%20Women%20building.pdf . Existing populated arrest month preserved; source exact September 9 arrest is flagged for precision refinement separately.
